question: We make an oral drug tablet colored with both D&C Red No. 6 and D&C Red No. 7. What does Part 82 limit, and does 82.1307 address our lipstick too?
answer:
The generated answer could not be validated against the retrieved regulatory evidence, so it is not shown. The retrieved sources were not verified to answer the question as asked, so their text is not quoted as an answer. Sources consulted: 21 CFR 82.1307(a), 21 CFR 82.5, 21 CFR 82.5(a), 21 CFR 82.5(b), 21 CFR 82.2051(a)(1) and 19 more.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 7.
sources.text: (a) The color additive D&C Red No. 7 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1307 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: General specifications for straight colors.
sources.text: No batch of a straight color listed in subpart B, C, or D shall be certified under this part unless:

sources.heading: General specifications for straight colors.
sources.text: (a) It is free from all impurities (other than those named in paragraph (b) of this section or in the specifications set forth in such paragraph for such color) to the extent that such impurities can be avoided by good manufacturing practice.

sources.heading: General specifications for straight colors.
sources.text: (b) It conforms to the following specifications:

sources.heading: Lakes (Ext. D&C).
sources.text: (a)(1) General. Any lake made by extending on a substratum of alumina, blanc fixe, gloss white, clay, titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, talc, rosin, aluminum benzoate, calcium carbonate, or on any combination of two or more of these (i) one of the straight colors hereinbefore listed in this subpart, which color is a salt in which is combined the basic radical sodium, potassium, barium, or calcium; or (ii) a salt prepared from one of the straight colors hereinbefore listed in this subpart by combining such color with the basic radical sodium, potassium, aluminum, barium, calcium, strontium, or zirconium.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 7.
sources.text: (b) The color additive D&C Red No. 7 may be safely used for coloring drugs such that the combined total of D&C Red No. 6 and D&C Red No. 7 does not exceed 5 milligrams per daily dose of the drug.

sources.heading: Lakes (Ext. D&C).
sources.text: (2) Specifications.

sources.heading: Lakes (Ext. D&C).
sources.text: (b) Each lake made as prescribed in paragraph (a) of this section shall be considered to be a straight color and to be listed therein under the name which is formed as follows:

sources.heading: Lakes (D&C).
sources.text: (a)(1) General. Any lake, other than those listed in subpart B, made by extending on a substratum of alumina, blanc fixe, gloss white, clay, titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, talc, rosin, aluminum benzoate, calcium carbonate, or any combination of two or more of these, (i) one of the straight colors (except lakes) listed in subpart B or hereinbefore listed in this subpart, which color is a salt in which is combined the basic radical sodium, potassium, aluminum, barium, calcium, strontium, or zirconium; or (ii) a salt prepared from one of the straight colors (except lakes) listed in subpart B, or hereinbefore listed in this subpart, by combining such color with the basic radical sodium, potassium, aluminum, barium, calcium, strontium, or zirconium.

sources.heading: Lakes (D&C).
sources.text: (2) Specifications.

sources.heading: Lakes (D&C).
sources.text: (b) Each lake made as prescribed in paragraph (a) of this section shall be considered to be a straight color and to be listed therein under the name which is formed as follows:

sources.heading: General.
sources.text: A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of this part, for use only in drugs and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color.

sources.heading: General.
sources.text: A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of this part, for use in externally applied drugs and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color.

sources.heading: General.
sources.text: A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of the regulations in this part, for use in food, drugs, and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications in this subpart set forth for such color.

sources.heading: Lakes (FD&C).
sources.text: (a)(1) General. Any lake made by extending on a substratum of alumina, a salt prepared from one of the certified water-soluble straight colors hereinbefore listed in this subpart by combining such color with the basic radical aluminum or calcium.

sources.heading: Certifiable mixtures.
sources.text: (a) A batch of a mixture which contains no straight color listed in subpart C or D may be certified for use in food, drugs and cosmetics, if:

sources.heading: FD&C Blue No. 1.
sources.text: The color additive FD&C Blue No. 1 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.101(a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: FD&C Blue No. 2.
sources.text: The color additive FD&C Blue No. 2 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.102(a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 6.
sources.text: (a) The color additive D&C Red No. 6 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1306 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 21.
sources.text: The color additive D&C Red No. 21 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1321 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 22.
sources.text: The color additive D&C Red No. 22 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1322 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 27.
sources.text: The color additive D&C Red No. 27 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1327 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 28.
sources.text: The color additive D&C Red No. 28 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1328 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter.

sources.heading: D&C Red No. 34.
sources.text: Calcium salt of 3-hydroxy-4-[(1-sulfo-2 -naphthalenyl)azol-2-naphthalenecarboxylic acid.
